newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 728-day bond priced at 97.30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 728-day bond priced at 97.30 pct.

text.p: The average price on an issue of 728-day Russian OFZ interest-bearing bond was 97.30 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
Dealers had forecast the average price would be in the 95.68-99.65 percent range.
The 24013 issue, maturing on May 26, 1999, the closest maturity date to the new issue, on Tuesday closed at 100.68 to yield 24.57 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:
On June 18 the Finance Ministry raised 4.27 trillion roubles by selling one-year Treasury bills making total proceeds from today's auctions 5.52 trillion roubles.
It has also repaid about 7.12 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of 245-day T-bills (series 22054) and paid 1.25 trillion roubles in interest on the series 24010 bond maturing in June 1998.

The Finance Ministry is also repaying the series 24010 bond early on a voluntary basis. The Central Bank will also offer selected bonds to banks after the auctions. Results of these transactions are not yet published.
